packaging: CAP layout: Reference_Implementation / Optimized_Implementation / CryptoCode_Implementation per instance, official KAT, test/{vec,speed,kat_check,golden} and build_and_verify.sh

steps: three-way build with the package's own flags
22 padding-boundary lengths, byte-exact diff vs official reference
golden vectors frozen from the official reference at packaging time
4097 KAT records x 3 implementations per instance

gm_rows: speedup = official_optimized_time / cryptocode_time, per grade S1..S8 (32 B .. 65536 B).
GM = geometric mean over the eight grades. Win line 1.05, tie band 0.98-1.05
